name: Tenday
summary: #Tenday is the first immersive reality show in China featuring 39 people with different backgrounds in a world like squid game.

name: Bellie and Whizz Minding Me
summary: Lovable forest puppets, Bellie the badger and Whizz the hare, teach young children how to identify and manage their emotions.

name: Moving
summary: Adaptation of Stanley Price's successful West End comedy about the perils of moving house.

name: My Good Friend
summary: Comedy drama about two elderly men.

name: No Strings
summary: Sam Jessop and Rosie Tindall is a couple who meet after discovering their respective spouses are having an affair together.

name: Nobody's Perfect
summary: Bill and Sam have both been married before, but they are currently celebrating 8 years of ups and downs together.

name: Anakhot
summary: Exploring the intersection of Thai culture and future tech, this anthology delves into the gripping moral quandaries sparked by their inevitable clash.

name: La mente del poder
summary: This Argentine thriller follows the president-elect's psychologist, who is extorted by a mysterious organization that threatens to reveal his darkest secret unless he gets the newly elected chief executive to resign.

name: Queer2Queer
summary: Q2Q features inter-generational conversations between LGBTQIA+ youth and elder activists.

name: Mickey's Spooky Stories
summary: Mickey and friends share fun-filled Halloween stories.

name: The Changing Face Of…
summary: The Changing Face Of… is a glittering new celebrity biography series with a twist: telling the incredible stories of those A-listers whose careers have endured across the decades. Hugely talented within their fields, they've also been inventive in how they've used their image to keep themselves in the spotlight. Through the prism of their ever-changing style, we reveal each star's amazing life story - the highs, the lows, the drugs, the sex and the rock and roll.

name: Don't Come Home
summary: A mother moves into her family's eerie old mansion, where she confronts dark secrets from the past after her young daughter mysteriously vanishes.

name: G&T
summary: Friends since childhood, Giulio and Tommy are at a college party, when, a little tipsy, they end up kissing in the bathrooms of the place. Since then, Tommaso does everything he can to erase that episode and even Giuls from his existence. But, inevitably, five years later the lives of the two intertwine again.

name: Sorgu
summary: "How many lies does a truth consist of?" Interrogator Cihan's father is found dead. The file of this suspicious death is given to Cihan's colleague Metin. As the truths about the file emerge, the deep love between Cihan and Metin will be tested. Because there is no one in this story who will not become a potential murder suspect!

name: Pecado Capital
summary: Carlão faces a dilemma when he finds a suitcase with stolen money in his taxi. He also forms a love triangle with a young factory worker and a widower.

name: Anjo Mau
summary: Ambitious and deceitful, Nice seeks social advancement. While working at the Medeiros mansion, the girl plans to win over the heir Rodrigo, but ends up falling in love for real.

name: Ancient Aliens: Origins
summary: Ancient Aliens: Origins takes viewers back to where it all began, revisiting the most compelling mysteries explored over the past 15 years of "Ancient Aliens." In each episode, experts like Giorgio Tsoukalos, David Childress, William Henry, and Jason Martell engage in thought-provoking conversations on topics central to the Ancient Astronaut Theory. From astonishing feats of engineering to enigmatic UFOs and sky gods, they delve deep into the series' extensive archive, reflecting on past investigations, sharing personal insights from their adventures, and offering new perspectives on the ancient enigmas that have captivated humanity for centuries.

name: The Other 'Arf
summary: Cockney model Lorraine Watts indulges in an on off relationship with upper class Conservative M.P., Charles Latimer.

name: Núñez
summary: An analysis of the long career of Jose Luís Núñez as president of FC Barcelona

name: Vicky Pattison: My Big Fat Geordie Wedding
summary:
Vicky Pattison: My Big Fat Geordie Wedding follows Vicky through the emotional rollercoaster as she prepares for her vows with Ercan. 

With the support of their family and friends, the couple plan for an Italian wedding celebration sure to be packed with the lavish style of Vicky's dreams, and a guestlist peppered with some familiar friends.

name: Our Farm Next Door: Amanda, Clive and Kids
summary:
Our Farm Next Door: Amanda, Clive and Kids charts the Owens' journey to breathe life back into a derelict neighbouring property they bought to plan for the family's future. The series sees Amanda, Clive and their nine children work with a team of local tradespeople to slowly bring their ambitious vision for the farmhouse - known locally as Anty John's - to life, tackling the changing seasons and challenging elements along the way, as well as getting to grips with the nature of restoring a listed property in a remote location.

Cameras also follow Amanda as she digs deep into the farmhouse's past and reveals the fascinating part its former owners played in local history.

name: You Are My Star
summary: A love story of a nerd girl who doesn't have many friends and a college star that everyone loves. How will their story end? Let's help each other together.

name: Хутор
summary: Artyom, an information gypsy, is trying to escape justice and is hiding from persecution in a "farm." The closed community is led by a Father who has renounced technology and other benefits of civilization. Numerous followers of the leader live by his laws, but with the advent of Artyom, the usual order of things begins to change. Sergey Romanovich's first project after returning to the industry.

name: Pai Herói
summary: After his grandfather's death, André Cajarana goes to Rio de Janeiro to try to understand the death of his father, who he grew up believing was a hero, and tries to prove his innocence.

name: Locomotivas
summary: Among the love stories and twists and turns involving the family of former star Kiki Blanche, there is a secret that will change the fates of Milena, Fernanda and Fábio.

name: Os Quatro da Candelária
summary: To be remembered, they must first be seen. This series reimagines a real police-led massacre in Rio de Janeiro through the eyes of four children.

name: Xian Ji Xun Zong
summary: Lu Fan, a biology student at Jiangxia University, was once a second-generation rich heir. However, after his parents mysteriously disappeared, the company changed ownership, and his girlfriend betrayed him, he lost everything overnight. To make matters worse, he inherited his father's massive debts. With no way out, he hid in his old family home and unexpectedly discovered an immortal living in a bonsai tree, from whom he obtained a cultivation manual. To find his missing father, Lu Fan embarks on an adventurous journey.

name: No tenéis ni **** idea
summary: Luis Enrique is, without a doubt, one of the most prominent figures in football and sport in recent decades. This series is a great opportunity to get closer to the reality of people from Gijón from their own perspective.

name: It's Florida, Man
summary:
This irreverent late-night comedy series brings to life unbelievable ripped-from-the-headlines tales of the Sunshine State - straight from the people who live there. 

Featuring interviews from everyday Floridians and playful recreations starring a rotating cast of actors and comedians, including Anna Faris, Jake Johnson, Randall Park, Juliette Lewis, Sam Richardson, Ego Nwodim and more, this hilarious and outrageous series sheds light on the viral, wacky and weird. 

Covering diverse topics - from mermaids to witches, extreme fantasies and feral bunnies with equal parts humor and heart, IT'S FLORIDA, MAN is a love letter to the beaches, backwaters, and especially the people of a misunderstood yet magical state.

name: GAME 7
summary: GAME 7 brings the two greatest words in sports to life in a new five-part anthology series. With first-hand accounts from both the winning and losing athletes that participated in these high-stakes showdowns, each episode goes behind the scenes to revisit the most iconic moments of the most memorable games in history. From the Chicago Cubs' drought-shattering 2016 World Series victory to the New York Rangers' win in the 1994 Stanley Cup Finals, the series will explore how this quintessential test of maximum pressure and extreme intensity weigh on the hearts and minds of the legendary stars at the center of them.

name: Silent Honor
summary: In 1949, Taiwan was shrouded in the shadow of the White Terror. The Kuomintang, unwilling to accept defeat, sought to prevent the new China from achieving national reunification. In this critical moment, underground intelligence officer Wu Shi, deputy chief of staff of the KMT Ministry of National Defense, disregarded his personal safety and resolutely committed himself to liberating all of China. As the highest-ranking Red spy in history, he was honored with the code name "Agent No. 1."With in just a few months, Wu Shi worked seamlessly with courier Zhu Feng and transmitted numerous top-secret military intelligence regarding Kinmen, the Zhoushan Archipelago, Taiwan, and other areas, making outstanding contributions to the cause of national reunification. However, fate took a turn. Due to the schemes of Gu Zhengwen, head of the KMT Secret Service, the secretary of the Taiwan Work Committee defected to the enemy. Wu Shi urgently arranged for Zhu Feng to evacuate Taiwan, but they ultimately could not escape the enemy's grasp. Zhu Feng attempted to trade her life for Wu Shi's safety, but her efforts failed.In the spring of 1950, Wu Shi was convicted as a KMT spy. Despite enduring extreme torture and losing sight in one eye, he did not reveal a single word. His loyalty and courage even earned the respect of his enemies. In the end, Wu Shi, along with Zhu Feng, Chen Baocang, and Nie Xi, heroically sacrificed their lives, leaving their unwavering spirit forever in Taiwan.

name: Our Dazzling Days
summary: "Our Dazzling Days" tells the story of children who grew up in family housing communities surrounding industrial plants and the factory they called home. In 1990, on the outskirts of Northeast China, a military factory stood tall, surrounded by shops, hospitals, schools, and residential compounds. The carefree "No-Brain" Xiaoman and the rule-abiding "No-Fun" Xia Lei became friends with Yan Xiaodan, a girl who dreamed of sailing the seas. Together, they lived through dazzling, sunlit days of youth.As their youth faded, so too did the factory's glory. The one who most wanted to stay, Xiaoman, was forced to go abroad to Japan to make a living, only to fall for a scam that nearly cost him his life. Xia Lei, the small-town academic, graduated and became a "Shanghai drifter," fighting for a place in the modern metropolis. At the dawn of the 21st century, Iron City's factory finally collapsed, and its thousands of workers scattered. Yet, fate brought the childhood friends back together. Xia Lei and Xiaodan, now equipped with knowledge, vision, and experience, returned home to revive a branch factory, joining forces with Xiaoman overseas to outwit the local bullies who had taken control. From friends to lovers, and ultimately to family bound not by blood but by shared spirit, the trio carried forward the "factory kid" legacy — a spirit of grit, loyalty, and resilience — becoming builders of their hometown's new era. Together, they write a passionate and romantic chapter about ordinary heroes shaped by their times.

name: W5: Avery Haines Investigates
summary: Avery Haines leads the new W5 Investigative Unit, showcasing her daring and immersive reporting.

previousepisode.name: We're Not a Cult: Inside Twin Flames Universe

name: The Heir
summary: It is China's first historical costume drama centered on the culture of Huizhou ink.Set in the mid-Ming Dynasty, a tribute-ink scandal disrupts the long-standing Huizhou ink industry, causing the centuries-old Li family of ink makers to fall from grace. With the Li family's reputation shattered, the Luo family rises to prominence, only to later face ruin due to political entanglements. As time passes, Li Zhen, the youngest daughter of the eighth branch of the Li clan, embarks on the path of ink making to support herself. Through talent and hard work, she became a dark horse in Huizhou's ink industry. Luo Wenqian, the second son of the Luo family, schemes to restore his family's fortune and single-handedly shakes up the industry. Together, Li Zhen and Luo Wenqian engage in a battle of wits with the rising Tian Mo family, ultimately bringing Li's family back to its former glory. With the reopening of maritime trade and challenges from overseas ink markets, Li Zhen produces top-tier ink that earns Huizhou ink the title of "The Best Ink Under Heaven." In the end, Li Zhen and Luo Wenqian become a couple, working together to preserve and promote Huizhou ink for generations to come.

name: Neil & Martin's Bon Voyage
summary:
Neil Morrissey and Martin Clunes are to reunite for factual entertainment series Neil & Martin's Bon Voyage(3x60') produced by Expectation for Gold, the nation's favourite comedy channel.

Having famously starred together as flatmates Tony and Gary in Men Behaving Badly, in this new series Neil Morrissey will take Martin Clunes on a road trip through France, the country that has become his second home. From Normandy, through the Alps and to Neil's home and cider apple orchard in the South, and taking in beautiful food, sweeping landscapes and fascinating local traditions, the two friends will reconnect and reminisce on a professional and personal relationship that spans thirty years.

name: Blue Bloods & Wahlburgers: Family Dinner Recipes
summary: Join Chef Paul, and Wahlburgers to cook recipes corresponding to BLUE BLOODS' famous Reagan Sunday dinners in each new episode, bringing family and friends together for a one-of-a-kind culinary journey.

name: Blenheim Palace: Behind the Grandeur
summary:
It's Spring in Oxfordshire, and at 300-year-old Blenheim Palace, the staff prepare to open for another busy season.

The Palace, a private residence of the 12th Duke of Marlborough, is the only non-royal Palace in England, and opened its doors to the public in 1950 in order to raise funds to conserve and maintain the Palace and its estate - and it's always busy for the staff who welcome nearly a million visitors a year.

Prepare to step into the dazzling grandeur of one of Britain's most spectacular palaces.

name: Cleddau
summary:
The shocking murder of a nurse opens old wounds in a small-town community, throwing a historic conviction into doubt, raising the horrifying prospect of a copycat killer and reuniting two former lovers tasked with finding the killer.

With twists and turns leading to a heart-stopping finale, Cleddau is a forensic examination of a town, a killer and a relationship, past and present.

name: Singles
summary: Romantic comedy series about two couples who meet in a singles bar.

name: Mr. Plankton
summary: Lee Yoo Mi stars as a bride-to-be whose medical conditions threatens her marriage to a family obsessed with continuing their grand lineage.

name: Six Dates with Barker
summary: A series of six one-off, half-hour situation comedies showcasing the talents of Ronnie Barker.

previousepisode.name: 2774 AD: All the World's a Stooge

name: Cashero
summary: An ordinary man who inherits super strength discovers a greater evil out to steal his power. The one catch? Every use drains money from his wallet.

name: Sounding Brass
summary: Sitcom about a brass band in Derbyshire.

name: Genie, Make a Wish
summary: A woman becomes the master of a genie who keeps tempting her to make a wish — sparking a risky, magical connection.

name: Can This Love Be Translated?
summary: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

name: The Price of Confession
summary: Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.

name: Bad Together
summary: Bad Together follows the evolving friendship between two gay men as they learn to accept and love both themselves and one another.

name: The Other Bennet Sister
summary:
The Other Bennet Sister is a fresh spin around the ballroom for one of Jane Austen's most unassuming characters: Mary Bennet – the seemingly unremarkable and overlooked middle sister in Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice. The series takes as its premise that - when it comes to the Bennet sisters - while we dream of being Lizzy, in reality most us are more like Mary...

Unlike her sisters, Mary isn't your typical period drama heroine. She is awkward, anxious, preachy, full of facts, a terrible singer… overlooked by her mother and seemingly destined to an empty dance card for the rest of her life… until Mary takes matters into her own hands.

The Other Bennet Sister gives Mary Bennet the epic love story nobody predicted for her, taking her from her family home in Meryton to the soirees of Regency London and the peaks and vales of the Lake District - all in search of independence, romance and, most elusive of all, self-love and acceptance.

name: Death's First Love
summary: This drama is a love story between Kataoka Sakuya, a grim reaper who comes to the human world for the first time, and Mochizuki Nayuki, a woman who lost her father at a young age and has devoted her life to raising her only remaining family—her younger brother. As they meet, they gradually come to understand each other, and slowly, they begin to fall in love. However, a fate that will dramatically change their lives awaits them both…

name: Впізнай меня
summary: The plot of the series focuses on the life of the main character Vera, the daughter of a former policeman. Father raised Vera strictly, trying to protect her from the outside world. However, their lives changed dramatically after a tragic incident that left a deep mark on the family. Vera's friend, Kateryna, is her complete opposite - confident, unbridled and defiant. Their friendship surprises even university teachers, as Kateryna is not overly concerned with her studies and is focused on the search for personal happiness. One day she decides to go to the club in search of a successful man, taking Vera with her. How this acquaintance will change their lives, viewers can find out by watching the series.

name: Трое
summary: Basketball! Football! Hockey! The three most popular sports will unite in an attempt to figure out how much sport is integrated into various spheres of life. Each host prepares stories on a given topic, and the expert chooses the brightest ones.

previousepisode.name: #24 МОШЕННИКИ. Позов, Гараев, Щетков | Косицын, Муратаев

name: Omg My Ex Become a Millionaire
Шеф
summary: Kai is a talented and ambitious chef in a trendy Moscow restaurant. He hopes to receive the title of the best chef in Russia and maintains a high level of service and service. One day, Kai comes into conflict with a boorish visitor, who turns out to be a high-ranking official, and loses his job. Desperate, Kai gets a job as a cook in a women's colony in the hope that eventually he will be able to open his own restaurant and win the country's main culinary competition.

name: I Wanna Punch that Scumbag!
summary: Hokomi Sato has hit rock bottom after being left at the altar on her wedding day. However, things start looking up when she meets the kind and compassionate Kairi Kuzuya. But in fact, he turns out to be the "worst womanizing scum of the earth!" Vowing never to be hurt again, Hokomi decides to change herself and takes up boxing, setting her life on a new course. Yet, she can't seem to keep Kairi out of her life as she begins to learn of his eventful past. Follow Hokomi on her journey to mental and physical empowerment through this no-holds-barred boxing love story!

name: NASCAR Countdown Live
summary: A pre-race lead-up to NASCAR racing. The countdown to this week's NASCAR Xfinity Series race is on as motorsports experts provide live insight and analysis on teams and drivers leading up to the green flag.

name: Просто завтрак
summary: Olga Belkovich is an expert in the field of home cooking, a popular culinary blogger, the wife and faithful companion of chef Alexander Belkovich, in each issue of the new project there are three breakfast recipes that are united by a common theme, but represent three different categories.

name: Największe polskie katastrofy
summary: Polish history is full of unexplained catastrophes. Though many people have lost their lives, their causes have never been fully established. Take a close look at these tragic events, finding new evidence, witnesses, and the latest expert opinions. All this to check the origins of the "greatest Polish catastrophes" and whether they could have been prevented.

name: Spooner's Patch
summary: Inspector Spooner is in charge of a small police station in Woodley, London. He's a vain, eccentric man who lives in a flat above the "cop shop". His methods of policing are rather unconvential and he's not averse to taking the odd "back-hander".

name: n00b
summary: n00b depicts a 2005 Gore teenager's social downfall from an all-around-party animal after he is outed as gay and loses his place on the college's rugby team.

name: Hjälp vi har köpt ett franskt ruckel!

previousepisode.name: Vem hade trott att duvrummet kunde bli så fint?

name: Dcera národa
summary: Karel Havlíček Borovský dies leaving his daughter Zdeňka an orphan. She is taken care of by Czech revivalists led by František Ladislav Rieger. Revivalists want to make her a perfect symbol of the tenderness of Czech culture but rebellious Zdeňka wants to live her life according to her ideas. When she falls in love with a Polish officer of the Austrian army she turns in public eyes from a girl loved by the crowd literally to a traitor of the nation and a whore. Will Zdeňka manage to assert her romantic love, or will she give in to the pressure and marry a boring landowner from a good Czech family?

previousepisode.name: A žili šťastně až na věky

name: Sora Wataru Kyoushitsu
summary:
A part-time high school in Shinjuku, Tokyo. Students with all sorts of circumstances attend the school. Yanagida Gakuto (21 years old) is a delinquent who can't escape a negative spiral. Koshikawa Angela (43 years old), whose mother is Filipino and father is Japanese, has almost given up on keeping up with her classes. Natori Kasumi (16 years old) has orthostatic intolerance and continues to attend school in the nurse's office. Nagamine Shozo (76 years old) was unable to attend high school as a young man and had no choice but to work.

Fujitake Kanae, an enigmatic science teacher, is assigned to teach these students, who are all different in age and background. With Fujitake's guidance, they aim to present their results at an academic conference based on an experiment to recreate a "crater on Mars" in the classroom, but various difficulties stand in their way, including their own disabilities, family problems, and unbreakable relationships.

name: Inside Barlinnie
summary: Inside 'The Big Hoose'. The reality of life behind the bars of Scotland's infamous prison. As it finally closes its doors, staff and inmates reflect on a violent, chaotic history.

name: Dadao Chaotian
summary: A person who has traveled all over the green mountains is still young, but when he suddenly looks back, the sword is just between his eyebrows, but in his heart. Jing Jiu, who lives in a mountain village in Chaotian Continent, unexpectedly receives Liu Shisui, who is born with Taoism, as a book boy. The two came to the Qingshan Sect by chance, but they were criticized because the "mediocre" Jing Jiu actually took the "extraordinary genius" Liu Shisui as his servant. At the sword inheritance conference, Jing Jiu also met Zhao Layue, a Sanwu girl from Shenmo Peak. Jing Jiu, who is surprisingly "lazy", just wants to practice quietly, but little does he know that fate will involve the three of them in a huge river and lake dispute... Under the Taixu, are the green mountains far away? Not far.

name: Good Luck
summary: An ordinary young man, Shi Lai, finds himself caught in an inexplicable fate with stones. Through three distinctly different romantic encounters, he suddenly experiences a turn of fortune, only to face a harsh setback… In the mysterious and unpredictable world of Gumie, a new adventure is waiting for him. How will this poor young man defy the odds and turn his life around to reach the pinnacle of success?

name: Four Kings
summary:
Unprecedented access into the lives of four of Britain's best boxers: Frank Bruno, Nigel Benn, Chris Eubank and Lennox Lewis. The series explores how the men overcame racial prejudice whilst breaking down barriers for black British athletes, as they transitioned into the mainstream media. 

The heated rivalries between the boxers turned nasty as half a billion people tuned in to see them settle their differences in the ring in the biggest week in British boxing history. 

An intimate insight into the boxers' lives reveal how they battled their own demons, throughout their careers and in retirement, and their struggles with mental health issues and the cost of the sacrifices made in order to create a legacy and pave the way and for those who follow in their footsteps.

name: Spy in the Troop
summary:
Building on the recent success of Spy in the Ocean, the series will deploy the most advanced Spy Creatures ever created to infiltrate groups of apes and monkeys. Sophisticated AI will enhance the Spies ability to communicate, allowing them to use the same calls and facial expressions as the primates they encounter.

With the ability to recognise individuals, the new Spies will be able to interpret emotions and respond appropriately. Through a series of intimate and revealing interactions, the Spy Creatures will shine new light on the thoughts, feelings and problem-solving abilities of primates, and lead us to reflect on our own species and the roots of human behaviour.

name: An Hour on Earth
summary:
Using pioneering seamless filming techniques, each film explores magic moments when Earth bursts into life - fleeting windows of time when the conditions are just right and animals spring into action.

From the rush hour just before dawn in the Kalahari, as desert creatures dash to beat the morning heat; to the hour after the rains in the Amazon, when the forest fills with activity; and from the hour of high tide in the Australian coral reef, this series takes the audience on a mesmerising cinematic journey through nature's most extraordinary moments. This is natural history on a deadline.

name: Matriarch
summary:
Dr Jane Goodall first began studying the chimpanzees of Gombe, Tanzania in 1960. Her pioneering work forever changed the way we understand the species - and her project has become the longest-running continuous field study of primates ever conducted. But until now, documentaries about the chimps of Gombe have focused largely on the males.

Matriarch focuses entirely on the stories of the females of Gombe for the first time. Produced in collaboration with Dr Goodall, and featuring revealing interviews with her and a team of scientists and field assistants, the series focuses on Gremlin, the alpha female of the Kasekela troop. At 54, she is the oldest chimpanzee mother ever recorded at Gombe - and she's held her alpha position for nine years through a careful combination of intelligence, patience and strategic relationships. But competing females are waiting in the wings - for when Gremlin's strength begins to wane. The normal rules of chimpanzee society may see power pass to an influential female from a rival family, but Gremlin has forged deep and caring bonds with her many daughters – creating a rare female alliance. Can they keep hold of the privileged top spot?

name: Irish Blood
summary: Irish Blood focuses on Fiona, whose path in life is earmarked by her father, Declan, who seemingly abandoned her and her mother on her tenth birthday. After years of channelling anger toward him, to the benefit of her litigious clients, a message from her father sends her to Ireland. There she learns key truths about her father as well as a family that doesn't know she exists, and, moreover, that the story of abandonment that has shaped her entire life - was a lie. A lie intended to protect her and her mother from her father's shady business dealings. Fiona resolves to uncover the full truth about her father and reconnect with the parent she only thought she knew.

name: A Great Day with J Balvin
summary: A Great Day with J Balvin takes audiences on a personal journey with J Balvin and his captivating quest to uncover the secrets of a truly fulfilling life. J Balvin is joined by a handful of his celebrity friends as they embark on a series of unexpected and transformative adventures together.

name: Dirty Work
summary: Leo Beckett is a private eye who takes on the cases his former mates in the police force don't want.

name: Millennial Money
summary: Millennial Money puts the "personal" in personal finance. Get an inside look at the lives and finances of millennials to see exactly how much they earn, what they spend it on and how they invest. From starting a business to changing careers, getting in and out of debt, creating an unusual income stream, or casting it all aside to start over again, young people reveal the steps they took to make it happen. Including how much they get paid, what they spend on food, shelter and fun, and how thy plan on saving for the future, Millennial Money takes a revealing look into the one area people seem to never talk about: their money.

name: Before They Kill Again
summary: To stop a madman before he kills - or kills again - sometimes the only option is to get inside the mind of a monster. These cops engage in high-stakes, one-on-one battles of wits with the most dangerous and deadly criminals, predicting their next moves before they strike. In these psychological life-or-death chess matches, only one will emerge victorious. Everyone is playing for keeps, and a single wrong move can have deadly consequences.

name: Feuds Turned Fatal
summary: Same here to avoid to many feuds: Retaliation and revenge unfold as friendships turn into furious feuds. As each conflict escalates, former friends, family members, and partners spiral from minor disagreements to murder. Both sides of the feud share their stories of revenge gone wrong.

name: Operation Undercover
summary: Operation Undercover is an adrenaline-fueled new series that takes viewers inside real-life, discreet operations run by police to keep communities across the country safe. Led by former undercover agent, Lou Valoze, this six-episode series offers exclusive, unprecedented access to undercover stings targeting arms dealers, drug suppliers, human traffickers and various criminal enterprises. With a 26-year career as an undercover agent, Valoze has faced the Chicago mob, outlaw biker gangs, and domestic terrorists. Now, he brings his expertise to other agents leading high stakes operations of their own.

name: We'll Think of Something
summary: Les Brooks is a middle-aged man who has recently been made redundant. However, he is determined not to become unemployed and join the dole queue, so he comes up with many schemes to make money, but each one fails. His wife, Maureen, has to take a job at the local pub to make ends meet.

name: Love Sucks
summary: Trained as a boxer by her father, Zelda fights in the family boxing ring against fairground visitors. That's where she falls for the sensitive and sophisticated Ben who hides a secret - he's a vampire. As Zelda is faced with this horrible realisation, she learns another secret closer to home - her family are vampire slayers and a brutal feud between the two families has existed for generations. While the tension between the two families grows, does Ben and Zelda's love stand a chance?

name: Asia
summary:
Asia, a natural history series about the wildlife of our planet's largest continent. Covering the length and breadth of Asia, the series will reveal its most remarkable landscapes and animals, and feature dramatic, previously unseen behaviour.

Filmed over the course of nearly four years, this is the first time that Asia has been the focus of a major BBC wildlife series. From the vast Gobi Desert to the jungles of Borneo, and from the polar wilderness of Siberia to the coral seas of the Indian Ocean, this series will showcase the breath-taking variety of Asia's wildest places.

name: Fervent Kiss
summary: After a car accident, Shen Hanxing discovers that her lover, He Chen, has been impersonated by his twin brother, He Can. Determined to uncover the truth, she pretends to be engaged to He Chen's uncle, Zhong Sihui, to get closer to He Can. As her investigation deepens and their relationship grows ambiguous, Shen Hanxing slowly realizes that the man by her side might actually be the real He Chen!

name: The Quirky and the Charming
summary: By chance, Yi Ran, who had been making ends meet with odd jobs, becomes a professional sleeper at a five-star hotel—only to discover that her new boss, Xiao Mucheng, is the hotel's director and her direct supervisor. As they tackle quirky guests and the hotel's business struggles, Yi Ran and Xiao Mucheng clash but gradually grow closer despite their differences.

name: O Espigão
summary: Lauro Fontana wants to build the largest hotel in Brazil, but he needs to convince the Camará brothers to sell the mansion they live in, facing ethical dilemmas and personal obstacles.

name: Guerra dos Sexos
summary: Cousins Charlô and Otávio once had a romance, but now they hate each other. However, fate plays a trick on them: they will receive a large inheritance, on the condition that they live together.

name: Anos Dourados
summary: A journey through the values of the Rio middle class in 1950, based on the romance between Lurdinha, a student with conservative parents, and Marcos, a student and son of separated parents.

name: A Gata Comeu
summary: After getting lost on a sea excursion, Jô Penteado and Fábio Coutinho develop a mutual feeling during the two months they spend lost on a desert island.

name: El maleficio
summary: Beatriz Almazan, a widow with a generous heart, dedicates herself to raising her two children after her husband's death. Her life turns mysterious and terrifying when she meets the powerful millionaire Enrique de Martino, whom she agrees to marry. After moving to De Martino's house, Beatriz discovers that her new husband is a sorcerer who worships a diabolical entity and has resorted to black magic to amass his immense fortune. He will fight for Beatriz's love, only to realize that the curse from which no one can escape is love itself.

name: The Office Movers
summary: Everett & Eric Saunders run a dysfunctional office-moving company. The goal is to build the business, sell it & never move furniture again.

previousepisode.name: Projected to Have a Blessed Christmas

name: Sassaricando
summary: After becoming a widower, businessman Aparício Varela takes over as president of Tecelagem Abdala and decides to win back the great love of his life, Rebeca.

name: DJ Mehdi: Made in France
summary: The story of the late DJ/producer DJ Mehdi, a young suburbanite of Tunisian origin who, during an early and extraordinary career, created the sound of the toughest collective in French rap and collaborated with the biggest names in rap in France and will subsequently become one of the most brilliant ambassadors of the "French Touch" internationally alongside Busy P, Cassius, Daft Punk, Justice and the Ed Banger label family.

name: The Forever Walk: China
summary: The Forever Walk: China presents the China segment of "The Out of Eden Walk," one of the most innovative global storytelling projects of our era, an epic multiyear foot journey by National Geographic explorer and writer Paul Salopek. This documentary series follows Paul's epic journey on foot across China, showcasing the rich tapestry of the country's cultural, natural, and historical landscapes through his unique perspective. As Paul traverses the ecologically and culturally diverse regions of China, he forms deep connections with his Chinese walking partners, offering viewers an intimate and insightful exploration of this vast and ancient land.

name: Dictators' Hideouts
summary: Dictators' Hideouts takes viewers on a visual journey through underground bunkers, remote palaces, and fortified complexes, revealing how these structures served as both symbols of power and sanctuaries from external threats. The series incorporates rare archival footage and expert interviews to provide a unique insight into the lives of these controversial figures and how these hideouts shaped their regimes.

name: Good or Bad Dong Jae
summary:
Seo Dong Jae is a prosecutor and works in the Cheongju District Prosecutors' Office. He is ambitious and places a priority on his success as a prosecutor. Nevertheless, he is not completely cold hearted as a person. Due to the label given to him as a corrupt prosecutor, his future as a prosecutor is not bright at all. While mired in trouble over a redevelopment case, he takes on a high school student murder case. He begins to walk a fine line between his intuition as a prosecutor and instinct as an opportunist.

This is a spin-off of "Stranger" (2017) drama.

name: Loups Garous
summary: Loups Garous, the world's best-selling French board game, is being reinvented like never before: CANAL+ is transforming this cult classic into a life-sized social experience.

name: Baddies Caribbean Auditions
summary: Executive Producer Natalie Nunn, along with music sensation Shenseea, reality stars Spice & Bobby Lytes and the Baddies East all-stars, help to choose the cast for the next season of Zeus Network's original hit Baddies franchise. Also featuring special guest, NeNe Leakes.

name: Baddies Caribbean Reunion
summary: The Baddies come together in LA to relive the Caribbean. Hosted by rap artist Saucy Santana and Janeisha John.

name: Just One Thing
summary: Continuing the legacy of Michael Mosley - and his mission to improve the nation's health and wellbeing through simple science. Even the smallest changes can have big benefits.

name: Our Beautiful Summer
summary: The story of A Reum, Da Un, Yu Ri and our three siblings who were born as quadruplets and lost the youngest, Na Ra, and became three, and the lonely summer when no one was there, meeting and falling in love again and becoming happy.

name: Landscape and Memory
summary: Series examining the relationship between culture and the natural environment, presented by art historian Simon Schama.

name: Australia By Design: Innovations
summary: Australia by Design: Innovations is all about Australian innovation, ingenuity and design excellence. It's about inspiration, disruption and changing the game. Join us as we feature 40 innovations that will leave you captivated!

name: How to Survive
summary: Clementine Jones and her best friend Imogen had so many plans for high school but when a car accident leaves Imogen in a coma, Clementine decides to vlog her day-to-day life so Imogen can catch up on all the drama at Attaway High when she gets back, and along the way, Clem learns a thing or two about how to survive high school.

name: Cook with Luke
summary: Your home of quick, tasty, good food. Cooking healthy and delicious meals has never been easier with Luke Hines in your kitchen.

name: The Glamorouse Revenge
summary: Lin Muxuan disguises Xu Zhaozhao to attract a hidden enemy for revenge. During their time running a beauty shop together, he falls for her lively personality, while their secrets and true intentions slowly unravel.

name: Fateful Love
summary: In this tale, there was a mythical Jade is said to cure all illnesses but carries a deadly curse that only the heart's blood of a woman from the Ruan family can lift. To break his fate of dying before 30, Gu Suizhi devises a plan to make the orphaned Ruan Shu fall in love with him. As they struggle between love and redemption, they unknowingly awaken a past-life grudge...

name: Camp Be Better
summary: 17-year-old outsider Niah is surrounded by spoiled rich kids after somehow ending up at Camp Be Better, a cushy alternative to community service for the offspring of the rich and famous.

name: The 4PM Club
summary: The 4PM Club follows the hijinks, romances, and friendships of a group of Attaway Middle School students who find themselves in the unenviable position of spending their afternoons stuck in detention.

name: Лига танца
summary:
Are you ready for a brand new dance show? The jury consists of the stars of your favorite projects, and the best teams of the country are on stage. 

Each team has three competitions ahead: a team number, a freestyle battle and a Tribute competition, in which teams create numbers on a given topic. 

Pure excitement and honest emotions are all that you have missed so much.

name: Tono To Inu
summary: In the warring states era, there were those who performed feats resembling demons or gods—though that is now a thing of the past. The Lord now lives in a completely declined and impoverished tenement. The Lord who has fallen into such circumstances, encounters a single dog. Feeling pity for its peculiar short-limbed appearance, the Lord reaches out a hand, but soon becomes amused by its mischievous behaviors. Thus begins the cohabitation of the fearsome Lord and cheerful dog, bringing peace and harmony to their lives!

name: Sousou no Frieren: ●● no Mahou
summary: Frieren loves collecting peculiar spells, and her ever-growing arsenal of magic contains the perfect spells for many occasions. Whether it be by stealthily removing alcohol from Heiter's drinks or by remedying her own sleep issues, Frieren is sure to brighten her companions' days with her magic.

previousepisode.name: Magic that makes you say what you're thinking, Part 2

name: Maomao no Hitorigoto
summary: Mini anime for Kusuriya no Hitorigoto released on YouTube.

name: Reverse with Me
summary:
Karan has dreamt of Kliao Khluen all her life. From a deep bond, their feelings slowly blossom into love. Each time Kliao Khluen is in danger, Karan receives mysterious visions warning her of the impending peril. Using her special power—time reversal—Karan rewinds time to protect Kliao Khluen. But every time she turns back time, it comes at the cost of a life, bringing new problems and greater dangers. Their relationship may not be destined for a happily-ever-after, but rather a heartbreaking loss.

Join them as they embark on a journey to discover the true love between Karan and Kliao Khluen, navigating the flow of time reversal and unraveling the mysteries behind the visions that continue to haunt their memories.

name: Tales From Oak Island
summary:
Tales From Oak Island explores the most captivating theories, legendary figures, and momentous events surrounding Oak Island.  Offering new information and key flashbacks, the series dives deeper than ever before into the incredible people, fascinating theories, and critical discoveries made by the many searchers who have devoted their lives to unlocking the locale's many secrets and treasures.  What could be hidden in the vault deep under Oak Island?  Priceless religious relics connected to the Knights Templar?  A stolen haul of silver from a sunken Spanish galleon?  The spoils from a colonial-era military victory in the Caribbean?  Could they all be connected to the same mysterious group of medieval conspirators?   

Mysteries will be explored and secrets will be revealed by those who have studied, explored and lived through one of the longest running treasure hunts known to man.

name: This World is Not Real
summary: Game designer Qing Wan falls into a long coma after a car accident. Her fiancé, Lin Xian, CEO of a top gaming company, tries to revive her by connecting her consciousness to the "Dreamscape" engine, a simulation system that has replicated the real world. However, when Lin Xian enters this simulated world, he discovers that Qing Wan has forgotten him... To help Qing Wan regain her memories, Lin Xian encourages her to develop a game about dreams called "Qing Wan's Forest." Slowly, Qing Wan's memories begin to come back to her. Meanwhile, Lin Xian's main competitor, He Fan, plots to steal the technology behind "Dreamscape." He bribes Lin Xian's assistant, He Lanxue, to plant a virus in the simulation, making the dream world increasingly perilous. Faced with these dangers, Lin Xian decides to sacrifice himself to rescue Qing Wan. At the same time, Qing Wan embarks on her journey of awakening..

name: The Unreal
summary:
It's a bit like Bosco meets Stranger Things as RTÉ One broadcasts a brand-new four-part mini-series for the whole family - and mixes the nostalgic with the surreal.

Set in Lough Dan in Wicklow, where the Kelly clan decamp to for a reluctant family Holiday. But the dilapidated holiday park isn't as dull as it initially seems to 12-year-old Kevin, his screen-obsessed sister Katie and their distracted parents Mary and Tom. In fact, before long, things get really weird.

name: Être un Hilton
summary: Documentary series on the tragic fate of Quebec's greatest boxers of the 80s and 90s, the Hilton brothers: Dave, Matthew and Alex. Marie-Claude Savard tells the incredible story of this family, gathers disturbing secrets about the involvement of the Montreal mafia, and accompanies Alex Hilton as he tries to put his life back together.

name: Destination Celebrity
summary: Journey with Destination Celebrity as it explores global hotspots from Hollywood to Paris, Saint Tropez, and Byron Bay, blending pop culture with travel envy.

name: Guyana
summary:
Nestled in the unexplored depths of South America, the tropical rainforests of Guyana remain largely unknown. The secrets of this unspoiled paradise are less well-known than those of the Amazon, despite it being home to a breathtaking array of species. The king of this wildlife diversity, the jaguar, sits enthroned in the shadow of the jungle.

This young male is ready to embark upon the most important mission of his life. He must find a kingdom of his own. His journey will take him through changing habitats, each with its own cast of animal characters. He will face other top predators, such as majestic caimans, impressive arapaima, and playful giant otters. Viewers have a front-row seat as the jaguar fights for his place at the top of the jungle hierarchy.

name: Junk Kouture Dublin City Final
summary: Watch this year's batch of eco-conscious young designers as they set to up-cycle the way we think about fashion. Presented by Faye Shortt with backstage access from India Sasha.

name: The Traitors Ireland
summary: In a castle, 22 strangers compete in a game of deception. Traitors secretly eliminate players nightly while Faithfuls try to identify them. All compete in missions for €50,000, but surviving Traitors steal everything if undetected.

name: Joseline's Cabaret Texas
summary: The Puerto Rican Princess takes her cabaret to Texas where everything is bigger...including the drama.

name: Dressing for Breakfast
summary: Comedy about friends, family and relationships. Louise is single, bright and attractive and, although she likes her independence, would love to meet Mr Right. Or at least Mr Reasonably OK...

name: Relative Strangers
summary: When Maureen Lessing's husband dies suddenly, she discovers that there was a lot more to his life than she knew. Maureen, an Irish woman who has been living in Germany for a number of years, travels to Ireland in an effort to piece together her late husband's double life, but gets more than she bargained for in the process.

name: Relative Strangers
summary: Comedy about a happy-go-lucky loner who lived a life free of responsibility until his unsuspected and unknown teenage son appears.

name: Hetero
summary: A close-knit queer friend group, struggle with the task of diversifying the line up of their school's GSA, Gay Straight Alliance, with more than themselves, before the two week deadline that will lead to the club's demise.

name: Haututu Hunters
summary:
They say you can take the boy out of the country, but what happens when you take four ‘city slickers' back to the whenua and ask them to hunt for their kai?

Funded by NZ On Air, HAUTUTŪ HUNTERS is a six-part series premiering on Tuesday 7 November at 9.00 PM on Whakaata Māori and MĀORI+.

The series follows popular Māori & Pasifika personalities Beulah Koale (Sala'ilua, Savai'I, Aele Fou,Upolu), Jordan Vaha'akolo (Ngāpuhi, Ngāti Whātua, Ngāti Maniapoto), Te Kohe Tuhaka (Ngāti Porou, Ngai Tūhoe), and Xavier Horan (Ngāti Awa, Ngāti Pikiāo, Ngāti Pūkenga) who journey back to their respective hau kāinga in Aotearoa and the Pacific.

name: Dance Rites
summary: DanceRites, Australia's national First Nations dance competition, returns bigger and better than ever at Bennelong Point. Join us for a celebration of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander culture.

name: Donal's Feasts, Fasts and Festivals
summary: TV cook and award-winning food writer, Donal Skehan immerses himself in the lives and kitchens of people of various faiths, to discover how the food we eat – and choose not to – expresses who we are and what we believe. In his pursuit of culinary enlightenment, Donal spends time with Hare Krishna, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim, Orthodox Christian and Sikh communities and reflects on the traditions and beliefs he wants to pass on to his own family as he explores notions of ‘food for the soul' from all angles.

name: Listing Melbourne
summary:
Get ready to dive into the glamorous, high-stakes world of Melbourne's luxury real estate market with the dramatic new series Listing Melbourne, premiering on Wednesday, October 23 at 8.30pm Channel 9 and 9Now.

Listing Melbourne pulls back the curtain on one of the world's most dynamic property markets, where opulent homes, multi-million-dollar deals and cutthroat competition are the daily reality for five elite real estate agents. 

Viewers will see the intense pressure these professionals face as they juggle demanding clients, navigate fierce rivalries, and seal deals that can change their careers.
But it's not just about the properties. Listing Melbourne delves into the personal lives of these agents, offering an intimate and unfiltered look at the struggles, secrets and relationships that can make or break them in business and life. 

From emotional meltdowns to high-stakes negotiations, Listing Melbourne is set to become your next must-watch TV show, showcasing all the ambition and drama fuelling the battle for Melbourne's coveted blue-chip addresses.

Expect fierce rivalries, shocking revelations, and a rollercoaster of emotions as these agents push their limits to stay on top in this ultra-competitive real estate battle.

name: Art of Flight: The Series
summary: This documentary series follows professional snowboarder Travis Rice and director Curt Morgan as they risk it all to make the film of their dreams.

name: THRU: The Pacific Northwest
summary: Experience a never-before-seen adventure as a team of strangers embarks on a 1,200-mile journey across America's wildest long trail.

name: Finnerty
summary: Finnerty will look to cut through the noise to bring unfiltered truth, sharp debates, and a focus on the most pressing issues facing America today while standing up for American values.

name: Beat Monday
summary: Working 9 to 5 sucks. The corporate machine only gives us a weekend to really live, but how much can you do in just 64 hrs? Now, two athletes are on a mission to show us how to take back the weekend and BEAT MONDAY. Beat Monday is a series of epic weekend adventures designed to push the boundaries of what's possible between Friday night and Monday morning. Along the way, adventure athletes Mike Chambers and Jason Antin get into crazy situations, inspire the audience with their perseverance and discover local cultures outside our daily bubble.

previousepisode.name: Can They Climb + Hike Yosemite's Iconic Tuolumne Triple Crown In 2 Days?

name: Warren Miller's Daymaker: The Series
summary: Adaptive backcountry riding like you've never seen before. Come along for the biggest days with Karl Fostvedt, Michelle Parker, Katie Burrell, Daron Rahlves and more in Daymaker: The Series.

name: Inside the Black Box
summary: INSIDE THE BLACK BOX spotlights the greatest artists of color, from actors to producers to directors, writers and musicians, and reflects on how one's complexion affected their journey to success.

previousepisode.name: Terri J. Vaughn and J. Kevin Swain Visit the Black Box

name: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers
summary: In season one, athlete pranks include the NFL's Baker Mayfield from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who goes undercover to blow the minds of Bucs diehards.

name: Gastronauts
summary: Culinary masterminds compete in a series of challenges created by the most unhinged comedians.

name: Ma recette est la meilleure de France
summary: Cyril Lignac sets off to crisscross the country to find THE best recipe in France alongside two experts in their field: Stéphanie Le Quellec and François-Régis Gaudry. Whether it's sweet, savory, a revisited regional dish or dessert, a family recipe or a pure invention, their recipe is unique in its history and these amateur cooks are proud of it! At the end of this competition, the winning recipe will have the chance to be marketed on a large scale

name: Sight and Sound In Concert
summary: BBC2 joins the Radio 1 In Concert programme in a Simultaneous Broadcast for an hour's contemporary rock music.

name: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !
A Sociopath's Guide to a Successful Marriage
summary: A Sociopath's Guide to a Successful Marriage follows Lalla Rook — a reformed sociopath trying to make it as a regular mom. There's just the small problem of a dead body — which she may have stabbed repeatedly — in her living room. As Lalla navigates getting what she wants despite useless husbands, needy children, private school admissions and the trappings of suburban life, she's unencumbered by pesky things like shame, guilt and morals. But as mysteries unfurl and bodies pile up, Lalla's dark past threatens to rear its ugly head…

name: Regreso a las Sabinas
summary: Gracia returns to Las Sabinas, where she grapples with a terrible secret and reunites with Miguel.

name: The Actually Really Very Difficult Show
summary:
In each episode, The Actually Really Very Difficult Show will showcase one of four exceptional children – AKA the Smartest People Alive – who tackle complex subjects amid the twists and turns orchestrated by a different school who actually make the show really, very, difficult.

From animals to Australiana, pop culture to history, sport to science, and food to plants, each themed episode promises a blend of educational depth and captivating entertainment.

And of course, no show like this is complete without the ultimate challenge, changing weekly and daring enough to even get the hosts eating a banana drenched in hot sauce – sure to elicit "yucks" from viewers

name: Shatter Belt
summary: From creator James Byrkit comes a collection of stories from the other side of consciousness. A modern mind bender for a new generation, Shatter Belt dives head first into the deep end of questions concerning our relationship to reality, our connection to the universe, and the endlessly weird paradox of free will.

name: Running Dry
summary: Join Dr. Len Necefer on a human-powered journey up the Colorado River, where he explores through the lens of adventure the myriad issues facing this vital watershed.

previousepisode.name: Yoo Seung Ho And Young K

name: Дикая кухня
summary: This is the project "Wild Kitchen", where in each episode 2 cool chefs in 32 hours must find ingredients for preparing 3 dishes and, most importantly, survive!

previousepisode.name: 6 серия. Мосин x Исаков | Выживание в Карелии

name: Jin Ye Chen Ni
summary: In order to save her brother who was in a vegetative state, Si Yue had no choice but to enter the Jian family and work as a substitute for the fourth miss of the Jian family to marry into the Lou family. By mistake, she recognised the frightening Lou Xiao as her fiancé. From then on, she was surrounded by enemies on all sides and Lou Xiao, the person she was most afraid of, became the one who protected her with his life.

name: Wonder Pets: In The City
summary: Wonder Pets: In The City introduces a trio of heroes: Izzy the Guinea Pig, Tate the Snake and Zuri the Bunny. These heroic classroom pets live in a kindergarten in New York City and travel all around the globe in their amazing "Jetcar" to rescue animals in musical, mini-opera-themed adventures. When the going gets tough, Izzy, Tate and Zuri always remember to combine their talents and abilities and work together to save the day — because together, there's nothing they can't do!

name: Marvel Iron Man and his Awesome Friends
summary: Marvel's Iron Man and his Awesome Friends follows the adventures (and misadventures) of best friends and super geniuses Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho as they work together to solve problems both big and small and protect their city. To help them in their Super Hero endeavors, they each have their own Iron Suits that allow them to fly and give them each enhanced super-strength. In addition, Iron Man has a Nano-Shield; Ironheart has a Heartbeat Bubble forcefield to protect people, and Iron Hulk has his strong Iron Boom clap and Iron Hulk Stomp. They work out of their beachfront base, Iron Quarters (IQ), under the supervision of their superpowered android, Vision, and their furry pup, Gamma, who has her very own Iron Pup suit and accompanies the Iron Friends on many of their adventures.

name: The Restaurant That Makes Mistakes
summary: Ten volunteers with Young Onset Dementia manage a high-end restaurant, navigating the highs and lows of running fine-dining with the guidance of renowned chef Ben Bayly.

name: The Edge of Sleep
summary: When a night watchman finishes his shift at work, he is terrified to discover that everyone in the world who went to sleep the previous night has died. Now he and a band of survivors must stay awake and uncover the secret of this global epidemic, before they fall asleep.

name: My Stubborn
summary: Jun, a mischievous high school boy known for being an expert in pushing people's buttons, and Sorn, a composed, orderly man who absolutely cannot stand kids like him, have been at odds since the day they met. From sneaking salt into toothpaste to hiding personal belongings, Jun's endless pranks have made Sorn loathe him to the core. But fate has a sense of humor. When Jun unexpectedly runs into Sorn in an unusual situation, what starts as awkwardness soon becomes the beginning of a complicated connection. The man who once firmly declared, "I don't like kids", finds himself slowly stirred by unfamiliar emotions. From conflict to closeness, the line between annoyance and affection begins to blur.

name: Every Moment That I Think of You
summary:
'I really want to give you the best of the world.' 

In the hot summer of 2019, the 18-year-old Chen Zihao and Yang Yuhang meet. Chen Zihao, who's often at the bottom of the class, accidentally discovers that the handsome Yang Yuhang, the topper of his class, is his secret pen pal of the past two years. Upon the chanced encounter, the two of them take the time to talk about everything and gradually, their relationship becomes closer than ever. But with the looming college examinations right around the corner, how will they go on from here? 

'Whenever I think of you, who are you thinking of now?'

name: Inverse Identity
summary: Yan Lu was being hunted, and in order to save himself, he grabbed Jian An, the young master adopted by the Jian family. After escaping, Jian An wanted revenge on Yan Lu and kidnapped him the next day. Jian An became interested in Yan Lu and asked Yan Lu to be his bodyguard. Yan Lu was forced to agree. Jian An uses various methods to "torture" Yan Lu every day. One day, the two of them were fighting, and their clothes got wet. When Yan Lu changed his clothes, the birthmark on his lower back was revealed. The hidden mystery of his life experience was revealed, and the conspiracy began to brew quietly. Jian An accidentally loses his memory and relies deeply on Yan Lu, who had always protected him. The two secretly fall in love...

name: Ginger's House
summary: RuPaul's Drag Race UK winner Ginger Johnson invites some of her RuGirl sisters round for a good old chinwag… before putting these queens to work with a few cheeky house chores.

name: Honeymoon Photographer
summary: Newlyweds Adhir and Zoya Irani's Maldives trip turns tragic when Adhir's body is found buried on a beach. Suspicion falls on their friends, family, and Zoya herself as the investigation unfolds.

name: 1000 Babies
summary: Enter a cradle of mysteries where a man with a dark past manipulates multiple lives through a series of cryptic letters and deadly games.

name: Lynley
summary: Tommy Lynley is a brilliant police detective but an outsider in the force – simply by virtue of his aristocratic upbringing. He is paired with Barbara Havers, a sergeant with a maverick attitude and a working-class background. With seemingly nothing in common and against all odds, the mismatched duo of Lynley and Havers become a formidable team, bonded by their desire to see justice done.

previousepisode.name: With No One as a Witness

name: Meta Exposed: Secrets from Inside the Tech Giant
summary:
Mark Zuckerberg originally created Facebook to connect the world, but many now question whether the apps under the social media platform's parent company Meta, including Instagram, are causing more harm than good.

This eye-opening seven-part 7NEWS documentary vodcast and podcast interview series coming exclusively to 7NEWS.com.au and 7plus,dives deep into the profound impact of Meta's platforms on our lives and society, examining whether we are facing genuine threats to our children and communities, rather than just moral panic.

Featuring insights from whistleblowers, insiders and researchers – including Meta whistleblower and former Facebook engineering director Arturo Bejar, News Corp Australia Executive Chairman Michael Miller, cybercrime analyst Paul Raffile, leading disinformation researcher Joan Donovan, and social media reform advocate Nicki Reisberg – the series sheds light on the true motivations and methods behind the tech giant's operations.

Hosted by 7NEWS Spotlight's Michael Usher and Sarah Greenhalgh, the interview series offers practical tips for keeping children safe online. It also features Wayne Holdsworth, who shares the heartbreaking story of losing his son, Mac, to suicide after he was targeted online via Instagram.

name: Tsunami: Race Against Time
summary: Marking 20 years since one of the deadliest natural disasters in history which spanned 14 countries, Tsunami: Race Against Time provides a 360-degree view into the heart-stopping events of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami. The powerful series, from executive producers Tanya Winston and Danny Horan of multi-award-winning Blast Films and directed by Daniel Bogado, Emmy Award-winning filmmaker of Nat Geo's "9/11: One Day in America," features personal accounts from survivors, scientists who raced against time to understand the catastrophic disaster and warn the world, journalists who broke the shocking news, and the fearless rescuers who risked their lives to save others. Told through harrowing video and gripping stories of survival and courage – some both seen and heard for the first time – the four-part series offers a comprehensive and immersive look at the destructive wave as it surged across the ocean, leaving a trail of devastation in its wake.

name: Kiedy ślub?
summary: A story about parting, recovering from the "end of the world", navigating modern relationships and relationships, sex and the reality of constant change. "When is the wedding?" is a comedy-drama that naturally tells about the world of today's young people, with contemporary dialogues and ironic, intelligent humour.

name: La France en vrai
summary: A collection of documentaries by France 3's regional network, broadcast in each of France's 13 regions, covering major social issues.

name: The Last Woodsmen
summary:
The Last Woodsmen takes us deep into the secluded wilderness with these courageous and highly skilled loggers as they literally risk their lives. It's a rarely explored, dangerous business which translates to incredibly engrossing television.

On a floating barge hundreds of miles from civilization, veteran logger Jared Douglas puts everything on the line to harvest the largest timber in the world. One misstep in this high-risk industry could cost tens of thousands of dollars, or even a life. Joining him at the edge of the world is a tight-knit crew of lumbermen who, with only axes and hand-held power saws, take down massive, highly valuable trees that can be worth up to $70K each.

name: Love Cheats
summary: Extraordinary stories of romance fraud, exposing the lies and jaw-dropping scams of heartless manipulators; and the fight to bring them to justice.

name: The Dark Crown
summary: Yu Luo was betrayed and murdered by someone she trusted, leaving her filled with hatred at the end. After being reborn, she vows to reclaim her life. Using her memories from the past, she rises to power in the financial world, only to cross paths once again with the demon from her previous life, Liao Youting...

name: Gu Le Feng Hua Lu
summary: Yue Yangyang is an ordinary musician who unexpectedly encounters Shao Yi, an amnesiac who has just broken free from an ancient seal. With Yue Yangyang determined to protect her sect and Shao Yi seeking to recover his lost memories, the two form a pact to support each other through their trials. As they face challenges together, love begins to blossom， only to be torn apart by a painful misunderstanding. To protect the world, they reunite once more, confronting hardships side by side. Along the way, they help resolve the lingering regrets of the fallen Twelve Holy Music Spirits and reignite the divine script, Feng Hua Lu. Through this journey, they mend their rift, grow stronger together, and ultimately join forces to quell the chaos stirred by Feng Hua Lu, composing a new future for the world in harmony.

name: Persona
summary: "A bodyless crime; An endless flight." One year ago, suspect Qin Hong disappeared after a revenge murder in Chencang. One year later, her boyfriend confessed that her body was dumped into the sea by him. Without anything was left. Both witness and material evidence are available. But without dead body, Detective Liu Wang remains haunted by one question: Is Qin Hong truly dead?

name: Chasing Dreams
summary: Princess Tilan of Xiangnan, bright and free-spirited, loses her peaceful royal life overnight due to a coup and awakens the ability to foresee the future as a "Blind Songstress." She crosses paths with General Tang Qianzhi, and through a twist of fate, they become betrothed, forming a deep bond. Meanwhile, Prince Zhong Xu of Great Zheng, obsessed with Tilan due to her resemblance to his late consort, seeks to claim her. As war and turmoil rage on, Tilan fights against fate, standing by her love and defying destiny to change the course of a chaotic world.

name: Love Conspiracy
summary: Born into a wealthy and happy family, Song Zhizhi fell in love with Yi Wenhan, a man who rose from humble beginnings, only to be betrayed. Scandal erupted, she lost everything, and fell from a bridge, but miraculously was reborn. In her second life, Song Zhizhi protected her family and took revenge on her enemies. By joining forces with Ji Baijian, the head of Jihong Group, Song Zhizhi uncovered shocking secrets hidden for years. This time, she was determined to reclaim everything that belonged to her.

name: The Wicked Game
summary: Peem, the youngest heir of the Yossinpaisarn family, returns to confront the family that once abandoned him, leaving him to grow up alone—with a heart full of pain and vengeance from the past he and his mother endured. This return… is not just to seek justice. He also has a plan to expose the wickedness of his father, Thanet, and seize power within the family. But things are far from simple—someone is always there to sabotage him or stab him in the back at every turn. However, Peem does not fight alone. He is joined by Than, a former elite police officer, who now serves as his bodyguard. From trust grows a bond. From employer and subordinate… blossoms a deep, undeniable connection. And this fragile spot—might be the one thing that shakes Peem's entire plan to its core.

name: No Romeo
summary: Summer camp standouts Summer and Crystal find themselves in the same dorm. Initially, they bond over friendly competition, but soon, auditions for Romeo & Juliet cause a shift. Pressures to land the part of Juliet come from their respective mothers. Little do they know, their mothers were once fierce rivals in the beauty pageant industry.

name: Love in the Moonlight
summary: In 1963, following political reforms, Prince Saenkaew is sent to Bangkok for an arranged marriage with Pinanong. Pinanong, who has had a secret crush on the prince since childhood, is overjoyed. However, her brother, Sasin, is suspicious of the union and initially clashes with Saenkaew. As the truth behind the arranged marriage comes to light, a deep romance develops between Sasin and Saenkaew. However, both must choose between love and family.

name: Eventyrlig Camping
summary: For ten years, Halvor Bakke has been refurbishing cabins all over the country. Now he brings all his knowledge with him when he invites six Norwegian celebrities to Raet Camping to refurbish six camping cabins.

name: Taste
summary: When good taste may lead us to good life, but good taste has a price tag. The tumultuous tale of next gen teens.

name: Geliebter Fußballclub
summary:
Relegation, transfer ban, horror scenarios. In the summer of 2024, the public perception of 1. FC Köln is at rock bottom. But what does the club actually look like? What do the professionals and managers think? How is the turnaround to the positive supposed to succeed? With the new documentary "Geliebter Fußballclub", 1. FC Köln gives its fans exclusive insights.


The first men's team forms the central theme of "Geliebter Fußballclub". In addition, the club is also presented in all its other facets. What challenges do the FC women face in the Bundesliga? Why do so many young players make the leap to the pros at FC of all clubs? Who actually designs the new FC jersey? And why are fans of all generations so passionate about their FC?

name: Ghosts Off Grid
summary: Ghosts Off Grid dives deep into the idea that everything around us is made of energy, even our own bodies. When we die, where does that energy go? In this series, the hosts search for electrical impulses away from the built infrastructure.

name: Tieta
summary: After being thrown out of Santana do Agreste because of her behavior, Tieta moves to São Paulo and reappears years later willing to take revenge on those who mistreated her.

name: Остров сокровищ. Знаки судьбы
summary: Participants literally sail to an uninhabited island to get its treasures. All the heroes are divided into three tribes according to the elements of water, air and earth. They will not only have to survive in unusual conditions for a whole month, but also pass tests to get resources, immunity or other bonuses. Each episode, the heroes gather in an amphitheater, where they decide who will leave the game. Only four will make it to the final, and only one of them will be able to take the island's treasures for 10 million rubles.

name: Sai de Baixo
summary: Sitcom that follows the members of a middle-class family from São Paulo living in an apartment in Largo do Arouche.

name: Yorkshire Air 999
summary: Yorkshire Air 999 gives viewers exclusive access to the high-risk, high-adrenaline world of some of the U.K.'s most advanced medics, saving lives in a place of savage beauty.

name: Soltero Cotizado
summary:
Hosted by the charismatic Montserrat Oliver, this show follows heartthrob Nicola Porcella, known as the "golden bachelor," on a Caribbean adventure filled with love, drama, and unexpected twists.  In a luxurious island mansion, Nicola will navigate a group of sensual women, all vying for his attention and affection. But not everyone is what they seem. Some are genuine romantics seeking true love, while others are driven by ambition and a desire for the show's cash prize.  

Living in a nearby villa, the women will be constantly monitored as they compete in various challenges to earn coveted dates with Nicola. The stakes are high, as Nicola is looking for a genuine connection. However, there's a twist: if Nicola chooses a contestant who is deceiving him, she could win the $50,000 prize!  

Nicola Porcella, a well-known Peruvian television personality, brings his charisma and likability to the show. After his successful stint on "La Casa de los Famosos México," he's ready to tackle a new challenge: finding love in a tropical paradise while surrounded by a group of women willing to do anything to win his heart.

name: Broadmoor: For the Criminally Insane
summary: Exposing the truth at one of our most feared institutions, by the people who were there.

name: Орел и решка. Новая жизнь
summary:
"Eagle and Tails" is starting a "New Life"!
Now the hosts don't just look into the most interesting, beautiful and amazing corners of the planet. They try on cities and countries for themselves and try to understand - is it possible to stay here?
The rules are unchanged: one host has a budget of 100 dollars, the other conquers new places with an unlimited card. "Eagle and Tails. New Life" is a challenge to modern realities, when you don't know where you will end up tomorrow.

name: Карьеристки
summary: Masha, Lara and Zhanna work in Moscow City, suffer from loneliness and lack of promotion at work. One day they get to the performance of a famous coach and fit into a career marathon. In exactly one month, the girls must achieve promotion by any means, and in case of failure, quit their jobs.

name: Australia's Best Pools
summary: Renowned landscape architect and TV Personality Dave Franklin, tours the country showing off the best in pool design and construction Australia has to offer.

name: Good Doctor
summary: A man with autistic disorder and a savant syndrome overcomes bias and discrimination by the society and becomes a paediatrician by utilizing his exceptional abilities that the disorder brings.

name: Somos Oro
summary: Vanessa and Marilú decide to leave behind the messed-up world they come from and set out to beat the system no matter the consequences. But when they finally start to see the fruits of their ‘work', they will realize that sometimes the mess isn't in the circumstances but within themselves.

name: Du gewinnst hier nicht die Million bei Stefan Raab
summary: In each show Raab competes against one of five candidates. Only who can answer all the questions correctly and prevail in duels against the the legend in duels has the chance to win the gigantic prize money: 1 million euros!

name: Les enfants sont rois
summary: A reality-TV has-been turned mommy vlogger fills her social media feeds with daily updates about her two precocious children. When her older daughter disappears and is thought kidnapped, the bereft momfluencer faces a police investigation that calls into question the very existence of child.

name: Chutney Sambar
summary: An orphaned street vendor unexpectedly becomes part of his wealthy stepbrother's family, navigating the challenges of gaining acceptance in his new circumstances.

name: Sram
summary:
Following the lives of teenagers that attend high school, everyday issues of teenage life, such as friendships, romantic relationships and mental health.

Croatian remake of the Norwegian series Skam

name: Elitstyrkans hemligheter Sverige
summary: One of the world's toughest challenges awaits the 18 women and men who, under the guidance of four former elite soldiers, must undergo tests similar to the selection tests that are done for an elite unit. The pressures are enormous and few can handle it

name: Sangmin Dinneaw
summary: When he was a kid, Sang Min spent time as an exchange student in Thailand where he stayed with Orn, the mother of Dinneaw who was very young at the time. More than ten years have passed with Sang Min back in Korea. The whole time, he didn't stay in contact with the family, until one day, Sang Min has reason to return to Thailand and stays with Orn once more. There, he reencounters Dinneaw who's grown up to be quite handsome.

name: O Auto da Compadecida
summary: Based on the play of the same name by Ariano Suassuna, O Auto da Compadecida is a comedy that mixes regionalisms and religiosity to tell the story of João Grilo and Chicó.

name: Il était une fois... ces drôles d'objets
summary: Did you know that behind a soccer ball, glasses or a spoon lie treasures of inventiveness and thousands of years of history? Each episode of this new series looks at an object. Through its creation and its developments, through the ages and civilizations, we approach all sciences, from physics to philosophy, including history. Each object of our daily life is the result of a long process and conceals a rich history of knowledge and human adventures. Never again will you look at your stairs, your pants or a computer the same way...

name: 首富千金偏爱送外卖
summary: 身价千亿的首富千金为了逃避父亲的逼婚，每天自驾直升飞机到指定地点上下班，随后便穿上潇洒的外卖服，再戴上安全帽，最后骑上可爱的小电驴去完成送外卖的工作。结果一个月过去了，不但一分钱没赚到，还倒贴了不少。关键词：女频，轻喜、反转

name: Чайная пара
summary: Olga, a talented artist, has been divorced for five years. But her ex-husband, gambling addict Vitek, continues to come to her and borrow money. The head of the workshop in which Olga works decides to take the happiness of her best craftswoman into her own hands. She woos Olga businessman Novikov, the owner of the hotel, to which she decides to take her employees on vacation.

name: Shane Smith Has Questions
summary: Host Shane Smith discusses the fascinating fundamental truths (if there are any?) of the most interesting and convoluted social and political issues of today.

name: My Perfectt Husband
summary: Saraswathi believes she is the only woman in her husband Bharathi's life. However, a marriage alliance for their son brings back a blast from the past.

summary: A reunion romance that takes place over 15 years when two men and women, who loved each other passionately when they were in school but had to make a painful breakup due to antagonism between families and the mischief of fate, meet again.
